subject: Take-home packet: problem set release & reviewer rotation
messages:
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>
To: Elena Morris <elena.morris@example.com>
Cc: priyom_das@redwood.com, marissa.cole@redwood.com
Date: Fri, 09 Jan 2027 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Take-home packet: problem set release & reviewer rotation

Hi Elena —

Thanks again for taking the time to interview with Redwood. Attached is the take-home packet we discussed (PDF) — it contains a short problem set (approx. 90 minutes) and a small write-up prompt. A couple of logistics up front:

- Deadline: submit your solution by 11:59pm PT on Wednesday, Jan 13 (we're giving 4 full days). If you need a short extension for calendar conflicts, tell us the latest time you can deliver and we'll try to be flexible.
- Format: a single PDF or a Git repo link is fine. If you submit code, include a README with run instructions.
- What we evaluate: correctness, clarity of reasoning, and the write-up explaining trade-offs. This is intentionally short; we don't expect production-grade infra.
- Review process: your submission will be reviewed by two engineers (one backend-focused, one infra/runtime-focused) and a hiring manager. We aim to complete reviews within 3 business days of submission.

I've attached: redwood_takehome_instructions_20270109.pdf (problem set + grading rubric) and a copy of the resume we have on file.

Next steps: please reply to confirm you received the packet and that the deadline works. If you'd like to request an extension, indicate by when you expect to submit.

Best,
Vanessa Ortiz
Talent Partner, Redwood Inference
vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0123

----

From: Elena Morris <elena.morris@example.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>
Cc: PartnerStaff Recruiter <recruiter@partnerstaff.com>
Date: Fri, 09 Jan 2027 10:03:14 -0800
Subject: Re: Take-home packet: problem set release & reviewer rotation

Hi Vanessa —

Thanks for sending this over. I received the PDF and the deadline works for me. I'll plan to submit by Tuesday evening (Jan 12) if all goes well.

One quick question: is it OK to use a small open-source library for parsing (I usually use a tiny JSON utils lib) or should solutions be zero-dependency?

Thanks — looking forward to it.

—Elena

----

From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>
To: priyom_das@redwood.com, marissa.cole@redwood.com
Date: Fri, 09 Jan 2027 10:20:00 -0800
Subject: Fwd: Take-home packet: problem set release & reviewer rotation

Folks — forwarding Elena's confirmation. Please see the review plan below and reply with any conflicts.

Proposed reviewer rotation for this role (Software Engineer, Inference):
- Primary reviewer (backend): Marissa Cole — focus on algorithmic correctness and clarity.
- Secondary reviewer (runtime/infra): Jonas Weber (I'll ping him separately) — look at performance considerations and any runtime trade-offs.
- Hiring manager: Priyom Das — final calibration and hire/no-hire call.

Tentative timeline:
- Submission by Jan 13 (candidate said Jan 12 likely)
- Review window: Jan 13–14 (2 business days)
- Calibration / debrief: Jan 15 afternoon (30–45m)

Marissa — can you take primary? If you're overloaded, flag here and we'll swap with someone else. Also — if you prefer to see a repo link instead of a PDF, we can accept either; candidate asked about small libs. My preference: allow tiny, well-documented dependencies but call them out in the README.

Vanessa

----

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com, priyom_das@redwood.com
Date: Fri, 09 Jan 2027 16:08:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Fwd: Take-home packet: problem set release & reviewer rotation

Thanks — I can take primary. No conflicts on Jan 13–14. I'll do the initial pass and leave line comments in the repo (or PDF annotations) within 48 hours of submission.

Notes for reviewers:
- Use the attached rubric (page 3) but be pragmatic — prioritize correctness and reasoning over micro-optimizations.
- If the candidate submits a Git repo, run the quick sanity tests I added to our internal runner (link below). Otherwise, annotate the PDF and upload to Greenhouse.

Quick links:
- Internal review runner: https://tools.redwood.local/review-runner/quick-sanity (internal)
- Greenhouse reply template (copy to candidate file): https://greenhouse.example/template/TAKEHOME_FEEDBACK

Marissa Cole
Senior Software Engineer, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com
